jobs.title: Director FP&A
jobs.description:
About CertifyOS

CertifyOS is building the data infrastructure that powers modern healthcare.

Today, healthcare organizations rely on fragmented and outdated provider data. This creates unnecessary administrative work, regulatory risk, and higher costs across the system. We’re solving that problem.

Our API-first platform automates provider licensing, enrollment, credentialing, and network monitoring by connecting directly to hundreds of primary data sources. We help healthcare organizations maintain accurate, compliant, and reliable provider networks at scale.

Our vision is simple: One API. One provider ID. Frictionless provider data.

We’re backed by leading investors and built by a team with deep experience in provider data systems. At CertifyOS, we value authenticity, accountability, collaboration, results, and openness to feedback. We’re building a high-ownership team focused on solving real infrastructure problems that impact millions of patients.



About the role:

As our Director of FP&A, you will be the strategic architect of Certify’s financial planning and operational engine during a pivotal phase of hyper-growth. Reporting directly to the SVP of Finance, you will build the forward-looking FP&A infrastructure, long-range financial models, and operational dashboards needed to scale our business. Your mission is to elevate finance from backward-looking variance reporting into a high-velocity, strategic engine that drives capital efficiency, revenue expansion, and company-wide execution.

You are a strategic thought partner who thrives in the dynamic environment of a Series B startup. You don’t just manage spreadsheets or audit static accounting data; you partner directly with executive leadership to unlock growth, optimize enterprise SaaS unit economics, and shape high-stakes business decisions. Bringing deep, pure-play FP&A leadership, you possess the rare combination of sharp financial modeling mastery and the commercial agility required to guide our next phase of growth.

What you’ll do:

 1. Strategic Financial Leadership & Growth Architecture
    
    1. Act as the core strategic thought partner to the C-suite and executive team, translating complex financial data into forward-looking growth strategies to scale CertifyOS over the next phase of growth.
    
    2. Look beyond rigid historical reporting; proactively identify growth levers, unit economic improvements, gross margin expansion opportunities, and optimal capital allocation models.
    
    3. Evaluate strategic tradeoffs across GTM investments, product roadmap expansions, and global operational headcount to maximize ROI and long-term enterprise value.

 2. Enterprise Forecasting, Planning & Strategic Modeling
    
    1. Own the multi-year long-range financial model, annual budgeting process, and continuous rolling re-forecasts across complex revenue structures (SaaS, usage-based, and hybrid models).
    
    2. Own the budget and forecast variance analysis and strategic monthly business reviews with core key stakeholders.
    
    3. Build dynamic, scenario-based financial models to stress-test business assumptions, price changes, market shifts, and aggressive scaling trajectories in real time.
    
    4. Standardize core business metrics (e.g., ARR, NRR, CAC payback, LTV:CAC, Magic Number) across departments to ensure a single, actionable source of strategic truth.

 3. Commercial & Operational Partnership
    
    1. Embed directly with Growth, Product, Customer Success, and Operations leadership as a proactive business partner to accelerate revenue velocity and operational efficiency.
    
    2. Partner with the Growth team to design, analyze, and optimize deal packaging, tier pricing, and enterprise contract structures.
    
    3. Establish clear, operational KPIs for functional leaders, translating company-level financial targets into team-level performance metrics.

 4. FP&A Infrastructure, Systems & Scale
    
    1. Push technology as far as it can go. You should come with an AI and tooling first mindset.
    
    2. Design, implement, and automate a modern FP&A tech stack (CPM/planning tools, BI dashboards, ERP integrations) to transition financial operations from manual spreadsheets to real-time analytics.
    
    3. Recruit, develop, and mentor a lean, high-performing FP&A team, cultivating a culture of proactive business partnership rather than backward-looking accounting. This will take place over time. To start this will be an IC role.

 5. Executive & Board Reporting
    
    1. Own the preparation of monthly executive dashboards, quarterly Board of Directors presentations, and key investor communications.
    
    2. Frame complex financial insights into compelling narratives that articulate operational momentum, trade-offs, and strategic risks to executive leadership and institutional investors.

What you’ll need:

Must-Have Experience

 - Proven Scale Leadership: 8–12+ years of progressive finance experience with at least 5+ years of pure-play FP&A and strategic finance leadership, specifically helping scale a B2B SaaS or HealthTech company.

 - Strategic Partner Mindset: Demonstrated track record as a proactive strategic business partner to C-level executives—someone who drives operational strategy and capital efficiency rather than simply auditing or reporting numbers after the fact.

 - Deep SaaS & Commercial Acumen: Expert knowledge of enterprise SaaS unit economics, go-to-market mechanics, net retention drivers, and complex multi-product financial modeling.

 - AI, Systems & Automation Mastery: Proven experience leveraging frontier models in day to day processes as well as for larger project initiatives. Experience implementing and optimizing modern FP&A planning platforms and building scalable financial infrastructure from scratch.

 - Board Communications: Direct experience producing Board-level decks and managing executive stakeholders.

Preferred Experience

 - HealthTech Domain Nuance: Familiarity with the commercial and financial dynamics of US healthcare, provider systems, usage-based API platforms, or healthcare data infrastructure.

 - Fundraising & Capital Markets: Direct involvement in Series B/C capital raises, debt financing, M&A execution, or IPO readiness workflows.

 - Global Operational Finance: Experience modeling and managing financial operations across cross-border structures (e.g., US headquarters with international operational or engineering hubs).

 - Investor Communications: Direct experience communicating complex financial strategy to institutional investors.



Benefits of Working at Certify

 - At Certify, we’re building with intention and taking care of the people doing the work.

 - Your well-being matters to us. We provide 100% coverage of health, dental, and vision insurance premiums for employees. Our US-based team benefits from unlimited PTO, with at least two weeks off each year to recharge.  In India, employees are supported with health insurance, statutory leave benefits, and additional wellness (menstrual) leave for women.



We are an equal opportunity employer committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to do their best work, and we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and experiences.

If you require reasonable accommodations during the application process, please contact recruiting@certifyos.com.

We are also committed to pay transparency and foster an open culture where compensation conversations are encouraged and respected.

CertifyOS is building the data infrastructure that powers modern healthcare.

At CertifyOS, we value authenticity, accountability, collaboration, results, and openness to feedback. About the role:

Certify is hiring a strategic data-driven marketing executive who elevates Certify’s market presence, accelerates revenue growth, and shapes how our products are positioned. Your work enables Certify to create measurable demand, communicate differentiated value, and support product adoption across health plans, providers, and enterprise partners.

You will be responsible for building a modern marketing engine that informs, attracts, and converts enterprise buyers. You will help define how Certify tells its story, how we educate the market, and how we partner internally to drive predictable growth. You must be comfortable operating in a high-growth environment, have mastery of marketing analytics, and bring an ability to influence executive stakeholders with clarity and precision.

This is a role for a builder who combines creative thinking with analytical rigor, translates complex products into simple narratives, and leads a high-performing team to consistent and measurable business outcomes.



What You’ll Do:

 1. Build and scale our growth marketing engine to drive predictable pipeline and revenue:
    
    - Own the development of Certify’s demand generation strategy across paid channels, content, SEO, ABM, events, and digital programs.
    
    - Build a predictable pipeline model with clear lead, MQL, SQL, and opportunity targets that tie directly to revenue goals.
    
    - Partner with Business Development to optimize funnel performance and improve conversion at every stage.
    
    - Own marketing analytics and executive-level reporting, including dashboards, forecasts, and quarterly business reviews.

 2. Lead Product Marketing, Brand Narrative, and Category Leadership
    
    - Own CertifyOS’s end-to-end market narrative, from product positioning to category leadership in provider data infrastructure.
    
    - Partner closely with Product to define clear positioning, messaging, and differentiation grounded in customer needs and market reality.
    
    - Lead the go-to-market strategy for new products and features, including segmentation, packaging, launch planning, and adoption measurement.
    
    - Translate product strategy into high-impact collateral, sales enablement, and competitive intelligence that improves conversion and sales velocity.
    
    - Drive market research, win-loss analysis, and customer insights to validate market fit and inform both product and go-to-market decisions.
    
    - Elevate CertifyOS’s brand through thought leadership, content, and storytelling that resonates with health plans, providers, and partners.
    
    - Execute a cohesive events strategy, including Blueprint, industry conferences, and targeted customer and prospect events, aligned to business objectives.

 3. Run a high performing data driven organization
    
    - Build and mentor a cross-functional team that manifests results through inputs
    
    - Establish operational rigor, forecasting discipline, and a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
    
    - Build and maintain a robust marketing analytics framework including attribution, funnel conversion, ROI and regular reporting on Company OKRs
    
    - Deliver clear, actionable insights into what is driving pipeline and revenue.
    
    - Use data to optimize programs, messaging, and investment allocation.

 4. Partner across the business to drive measurable growth
    
    - Collaborate with Product, BD, Partnerships, Customer Success, and Operations to align growth strategy with company priorities.
    
    - Support partnership and reseller motions by creating co-marketing programs and joint campaigns with Certify’s strategic partners.
    
    - Ensure all marketing efforts reinforce customer value, improve adoption, and support long-term retention.



What Success Looks Like:

 - Certify achieves consistent quarter-over-quarter pipeline growth aligned to revenue targets, driven by predictable and scalable demand generation programs.

 - Marketing reliably forecasts lead and pipeline contribution, supported by clear dashboards, attribution models, and performance reporting.

 - Product launches are coordinated and repeatable, with strong messaging, cross-functional alignment, and measurable adoption and pipeline impact.

 - Certify’s brand continues to strengthen, with customers, prospects, and partners clearly understanding why our platform leads provider data infrastructure.

 - Sales and Business Development consistently report that marketing collateral and enablement improve conversion rates and shorten sales cycles.

 - The executive team receives quarterly, actionable insights on marketing performance, competitive positioning, and market trends to support strategic decisions.

 - Marketing, Product, and Business Development operate in tight alignment, with shared goals, shared success metrics, and clear ownership across the funnel.

 - Certify is recognized as a thought leader in provider data, credentialing, and healthcare data infrastructure through content, events, and partner-led storytelling.

 - A high-performing marketing team operates with clear OKRs, strong accountability, and credibility across the organization.

 - Marketing investments are data-driven, regularly reviewed with Executive and Growth leadership, and tied to measurable gains in awareness, engagement, pipeline, and revenue.



What You’ll Need:

 - 12+ years of experience leading growth marketing, product marketing, or integrated marketing functions in SaaS or healthcare technology.

 - History of managing a demand generation engine with measurable revenue impact.

 - Expertise in marketing analytics, attribution, funnel performance, and ROI modeling.

 - Experience partnering closely with product teams to define positioning, launch new products, and influence roadmaps.

 - Strong executive presence and an ability to communicate performance, insights, and recommendations to senior leaders and board members.

 - Ability to translate complex technologies into simple and compelling messaging.

 - Experience scaling marketing teams in fast-paced, high-growth environments.

 - Strong hands-on leadership style with an ability to operate strategically and tactically

 - Familiarity with optimizing marketing technology stacks across industry products

 - A passion for improving healthcare through better data and operational efficiency



Benefits of Working at Certify

 - At Certify, we’re building with intention and taking care of the people doing the work.

 - Your well-being matters to us. We provide 100% coverage of health, dental, and vision insurance premiums for employees. Our US-based team benefits from unlimited PTO, with at least two weeks off each year to recharge.  In India, employees are supported with health insurance, statutory leave benefits, and additional wellness (menstrual) leave for women.



We are an equal opportunity employer committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to do their best work, and we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and experiences.

About the role:

We are seeking a Senior Manager of Brand Marketing to own Certify's brand presence, content output, and audience-building channels end-to-end. This is a high-impact, creative-meets- strategic role for someone who can simultaneously build a cohesive brand identity and operatethe full content engine that brings it to life — from thought leadership to LinkedIn, events,podcasts, employer brand, and corporate communications.

You will help define how Certify shows up in the market — shaping perception among healthplan buyers, potential hires, and industry stakeholders. This role requires equal parts brandvision and content discipline. You will own the editorial calendar, manage all owned channels,and ensure every piece of content is consistent, compelling, and connected to businessobjectives.



What you'll do:

1. Brand Development & Identity

 - Steward Certify's brand identity — including voice, tone, visual language, and positioning ensuring consistency across all internal and external touchpoints.

 - Maintain and help evolve the living brand guidelines system — covering written style, design standards, messaging hierarchies, and channel-specific adaptations.

 - Lead periodic brand audits to evaluate consistency, resonance, and market perception, using findings to evolve the brand as Certify grows.

 - Partner with Product Marketing and leadership to ensure brand positioning is tightly integrated with Certify's market strategy and competitive narrative.

2. Content Strategy & Production

 - Own the master content strategy and editorial calendar, ensuring all content reinforces CertifyOS’ brand narrative, category POV, campaign priorities, and audience insights across channels.

 - Develop distinctive thought leadership that translates market trends, customer pain points, regulatory pressure, and product strategy into compelling content for health plan executives and provider operations leaders.

 - Lead the creation of high-quality content across articles, blogs, LinkedIn, newsletters, video scripts, webinars, event presentations, white papers, contributed industry pieces, and sales enablement assets.

 - Build a repeatable content production engine using AI tools, internal SMEs, customer insights, and external partners to scale output without sacrificing quality, originality, or editorial rigor.

 - Partner with Marketing, BD, Product, Customer Success, and the executive team to ensure content directly supports pipeline creation, customer education, product launches, events, and market authority.

3. Owned Channels: Podcast, LinkedIn & Newsletter

 - Own and operate Certify's podcast — from guest strategy and topic selection to production workflow, episode publishing, and audience growth.

 - Drive Certify's LinkedIn presence as a brand-building channel — developing a content cadence, growing follower engagement, and managing both company page and executive ghostwriting programs.

 - Build and grow Certify's owned newsletter — developing the editorial voice, subscriber growth strategy, and content rhythm that turns subscribers into advocates.

 - Track channel-level performance metrics and use data to continuously optimize content type, frequency, and distribution strategy.

4. Events & Sponsorships

 - Own Certify's events strategy — identifying, evaluating, and executing on industry conferences, roundtables, webinars, and proprietary events that build brand visibility and pipeline.

 - Manage event logistics end-to-end: booth presence, speaker submissions, session content, on-site materials, and post-event follow-up campaigns.

 - Build Certify's own event programming — from customer advisory board meetings to hosted industry roundtables — that positions Certify as a convener in the PDM space.

5. Employer Brand & Internal Communications

 - Develop and execute Certify's employer brand strategy — defining what it means to work at Certify and translating that into recruiting content, Glassdoor presence, careers page, and social storytelling.

 - Partner with People & Talent to build a talent marketing program that attracts mission- driven candidates who align with Certify's culture and values.

 - Own corporate communications — drafting executive announcements, company updates, investor communications, and press releases in Certify's voice.

 - Build internal brand engagement programs that reinforce culture and ensure employees are proud ambassadors of the Certify brand externally.
   
   

What Success Looks Like

 - Brand Consistency: A documented brand guidelines system live within 60 days; 100% of external content passing brand review within 90 days.

 - Content Velocity: Weekly content output across LinkedIn, blog, and newsletter sustained at scale; editorial calendar planned 4+ weeks ahead.

 - Podcast Growth: Podcast launched within 90 days; 10+ episodes published within 6 months with measurable audience growth quarter over quarter.

 - Channel Performance: LinkedIn follower growth ≥20% quarter over quarter; newsletter open rates above industry benchmark; event ROI tracked and reported.

 - Employer Brand: Certify employer brand presence established on LinkedIn and Glassdoor within 60 days; measurable improvement in qualified inbound applications.



What you'll need:

Must-Have Experience

 - 6–10+ years in brand marketing, content strategy, or editorial leadership — with a track record of building or transforming a brand at a healthcare or technology company.

 - Demonstrated experience owning content operations at scale — building editorial systems, managing production workflows, and maintaining quality across high-volume output.

 - Hands-on experience managing owned media channels: LinkedIn company presence, newsletters, podcasts, or video programs.

 - Strong writing and editorial skills — able to produce excellent content yourself and set the standard for others.

 - Proven ability to translate business goals into brand narratives and content strategies that resonate with B2B buyers and talent audiences alike.



Preferred Experience

 - Background in healthtech, health plan operations, or B2B enterprise SaaS with complex buyer audiences.

 - Experience with AI-driven content workflows — using tools like LLMs, automation platforms, or content intelligence software to scale output efficiently.

 - Experience managing or contributing to executive thought leadership programs and ghostwriting programs.

 - Familiarity with demand generation and ABM — understanding how brand content feeds pipeline and measuring brand's contribution to revenue.
   

Our Research & Culture Principles

 - Ground Truth First: No insight without validation. You talk to customers, prospects, and the market — you don’t just read reports.

 - Insight to Action: Research without a recommended action is incomplete. You close the loop between intelligence and business impact.

 - Low Ego, High Standards: Nothing is beneath you — you dive into the data, own the details, and hold yourself accountable to outcomes.

 - Prioritize Relentlessly: The market generates infinite signals. You know which ones matter and focus your energy accordingly.

 - Deliver A+ Work: “Good enough” is not our bar. The quality of your research reflects on Certify’s credibility with customers, investors, and partners.



Benefits of Working at Certify

 - At Certify, we’re building with intention and taking care of the people doing the work.

 - Your well-being matters to us. We provide 100% coverage of health, dental, and vision insurance premiums for employees. Our US-based team benefits from unlimited PTO, with at least two weeks off each year to recharge.  In India, employees are supported with health insurance, statutory leave benefits, and additional wellness (menstrual) leave for women.



We are an equal opportunity employer committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to do their best work, and we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and experiences.

If you require reasonable accommodations during the application process, please contact recruiting@certifyos.com.

We are also committed to pay transparency and foster an open culture where compensation conversations are encouraged and respected.
